dogecoin.text: The intrinsic value of dogecoin is $0. There is no applicable use for it. The only reason people have to buy it is because of this artificial trend supported by influencers. Eventually the value of an asset will revert back to it’s relative value despite artificial growth.

In order to sustain price levels, dogecoin buyers will need to continually purchase all coins being created because there is no scarcity to support the price. It's similar to shoveling snow off your driveway in a never-ending blizzard, the snow will eventually win.

In 2014 Dogecoin co-founder Jackson Palmer decided to completely remove the cryptocurrency’s supply cap in a bid to dissuade people from holding it. This means dogecoin has an inflationary supply and new coins are continuously pouring into the market.
Reasons Dogecoin will inevitably drop. (A Thread)
